neighbours.label: the determiner ' other' before a plural or mass noun ('in other countries', 'other students')
fire: Prices for this medicine are much lower in other countries.
She asked whether other parents had noticed the same problem.
The test was later repeated with other materials and gave the same result.
Many of the ideas came from other teams working on similar projects.
Swelling can also spread to other parts of the body.
He was happy to learn from other players at the club.
The rule does not apply to other kinds of vehicles.
Readers can find tips shared by other gardeners in the forum.
